 Rusty’s First Alert 6 Forecast: Many chances of rain over a mild final week of October 
 By Rusty Lord Published : Oct. 26, 2026 at 5:27 AM CDT Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google OMAHA, Neb. (WOWT) - The final week of October starts with some rain on the radar with the steadiest likely to be west and northwest of the metro. That’s where the heaviest rain will likely fall. Rain chances persist into the evening as well.
 Next 24 hours (First Alert 6) Next 24 hours (First Alert 6) Where the rain is the most persistent the temperatures are likely to be the coolest. Highs will range quite a bit from NW to SE today with the warmest likely SE.
 Today (First Alert 6) Today (First Alert 6) Some showers could linger overnight into early early Tuesday with mostly cloudy sky winning out otherwise.
 Tuesday (First Alert 6) 3 Day FOrecast (First Alert 6) More rain is likely to develop on Wednesday, especially in the PM hours and there could be some thunder, lightning and downpours with that round. Wind gusts to 30 mph are likely to be noteworthy as well.
 Wednesday (First Alert 6) Thursday is expected to by rather dry with highs in the lower 70s. That’s before more widespread rain and the best chances of the week move in on Friday. Some thunderstorms are likely with that too.
 10 Day Forecast (First Alert 6) Yes, there are some rain chances for Halloween Saturday and the Husker game that night but at this point I do not expect a washout. Showers should be light and scattered as the forecast looks now. It will be mild in the 60s cooling to the 50s with a subtle south breeze too.
 Saturday (First Alert 6) No threat of a frost or freeze for the rest of the month either so you can keep those plants going outdoors!
